about: 차이분석(E040809) 재료비단가차이 · 소모수량차이 — 2026-10-21 원본 실측: 생산입고 II C001 포장김치 7(BOM 배추 1 · 고추가루 0.1 · 포장재 1) 소모 배추 8 · 고추가루 0.7 · 포장재 7 → 그 달 [표준원가생성] · [생성] 뒤 줄 = 생산품목 × 소모품목, 머리 2줄 [생산품목 · 소모품목 · 비교]. 재료비단가차이 차이 = 표준단가 − 실제단가, 차이금액 = 차이 × 표준소모수량(배추 −1,919.5 × 187 = −358,947) / 소모수량차이 차이 = 표준소모수량 − 실제소모수량, 차이금액 = 차이 × 실제단가(179 × 1,919.5 = 343,591). 실제단가 = 원가생성 결과 그 품목 감소 단가. 우리 자료로 같은 흐름: ITM-0002 AQD 센서모듈 7(BOM 판재 1 · 방청유 0.05) 소모 판재 8 · 방청유 0.35 → 수정 9 → 삭제. 원가 기간이 있으면 건드리지 않고 멈춘다(남의 자료). 원가비교집계표(2026-10-21 4바퀴): 실제금액 = 그 달 생산입고 소모수량 × 원가생성 감소 단가 합(원본 C001 22,714 = 15,356 + 7,003 + 355), 실제단가 = 실제금액 ÷ 생산수량(121), 차이 = 표준 − 실제. 노무비/경비(2026-10-21 5바퀴): 원본 배부 = 공정 노무비 × (생산수량 × 품목 가중치[표준노무시간 · 경비가중치]) ÷ 공정적수 — C001 포장 180 × 1, 포장 노무비 700 · 경비 350 → 700 · 350, 노무비/경비/외주비차이 노무비 4 · -4 · -700 · 경비 2 · -2 · -350(차이 = 표준 − 실제). 우리: ITM-0002 BOR 조립(PRC-040) 한 줄 + 조립 노무비 700 · 경비 350 → 7개에 700 · 350 → 노무비 실제 100 · 차이 -100 · -700, 경비 50 · -50 · -350, 원가계산내역 노무비 700 · 경비 350 · 생산입고 금액 = 소모 × 소모 품목 총평균 단가.

shots.name: 생산입고 II 소모를 BOM 과 다르게 → 원가생성 → 차이분석 두 갈래가 생산품목 × 소모품목 · 원본 식
steps: js:(async()=>{const W=(ms)=>new Promise((r)=>setTimeout(r,ms));const set=(el,v)=>{Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set.call(el,v);el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}))};const tr=[...document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')].find((r)=>r.innerText.includes('ITM-0002'));[...tr.querySelectorAll('button,a')].find((b)=>/BOR등록/.test(b.innerText)).click();await W(1500);let d=[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]')].pop();[...d.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b)=>b.title==='생산공정 * 선택').click();await W(1500);const d2=[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]')].pop();const pr=[...d2.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')].find((r)=>r.innerText.includes('PRC-040'));(pr.querySelector('a,button')||pr).click();await W(800);d=[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]')].pop();const ins=[...d.querySelectorAll('input')];set(ins[3],'QA재고2-조립');set(ins[7],'1');set(ins[8],'QA재고2');await W(300);[...d.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b)=>b.innerText.trim()==='등록').click();await W(2000);sessionStorage.setItem('qaVarBor','1');const b=await (await fetch('/api/bor',{headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token')}})).json();return JSON.stringify((b.rows??b).filter((o)=>o.productCode==='ITM-0002').map((o)=>o.processName+':'+o.workName))})()

js:(async()=>{const W=(ms)=>new Promise((r)=>setTimeout(r,ms));const btn=(l)=>[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((e)=>e.offsetParent&&(e.getAttribute('aria-label')===l||e.title===l));const pick=async(t)=>{const tr=[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog] tbody tr')].find((r)=>r.innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' ').includes(t));(tr.querySelector('a,button')||tr).click();await W(800)};const set=(el,v)=>{Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set.call(el,v);el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}))};btn('생산된공장 코드도움').click();await W(1200);await pick('WH-01 본사창고');btn('받는창고 코드도움').click();await W(1200);await pick('WH-01 본사창고');btn('생산품목 선택').click();await W(1500);await pick('ITM-0002 AQD');await W(400);let tds=document.querySelector('table tbody tr').querySelectorAll('td');set(tds[6].querySelector('input'),'7');set(tds[10].querySelector('input'),'QA재고2');await W(300);[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b)=>b.offsetParent&&b.innerText.trim()==='BOM풀기').click();await W(1500);tds=document.querySelector('table tbody tr').querySelectorAll('td');set(tds[5].querySelector('input'),'8');set(tds[6].querySelector('input'),'QA재고2');await W(300);[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b)=>b.offsetParent&&b.innerText.trim()==='저장(F8)').click();await W(2500);const d=await (await fetch('/api/productions',{headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token')}})).json();const p=(d.rows??d).find((x)=>x.note==='QA재고2'&&x.producedQty===7);sessionStorage.setItem('qaVarProd',p?p.prodNo:'');return p?p.prodNo+' '+p.materials.map((m)=>m.componentCode+':'+m.quantity).join(','):'none'})()

js:(async()=>{const W=(ms)=>new Promise((r)=>setTimeout(r,ms));const B=(t,root=document)=>[...root.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b)=>b.innerText.trim()===t);const L=()=>[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]')].pop();window.confirm=()=>true;sessionStorage.setItem('qaVarCp','1');B('신규(F2)').click();await W(600);B('저장(F8)',L()).click();await W(1500);B('닫기',L())?.click();await W(300);B('노무비/경비등록').click();await W(1500);{const d=L();const set=(el,v)=>{Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set.call(el,v);el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}))};const lab=[...d.querySelectorAll('input')].find((x)=>/^조립 .* 노무비$/.test(x.getAttribute('aria-label')||''));const oh=[...d.querySelectorAll('input')].find((x)=>x.getAttribute('aria-label')===lab.getAttribute('aria-label').replace(/노무비$/,'경비'));set(lab,'700');set(oh,'350');await W(300);B('저장(F8)',d).click();await W(1500)}B('표준원가생성').click();await W(2000);B('생성').click();await W(600);B('적용(F8)',L()).click();for(let i=0;i<10&&!document.body.innerText.includes('원가생성] 작업이 완료되었습니다');i++)await W(1000);return document.body.innerText.includes('원가생성] 작업이 완료되었습니다')})()

js:(async()=>{const W=(ms)=>new Promise((r)=>setTimeout(r,ms));window.__our=async(m)=>{let p=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b)=>b.innerText.trim()===m&&b.offsetParent);if(!p){[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b)=>/Search\(F3\)/.test(b.innerText)&&b.offsetParent)?.click();await W(600);p=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b)=>b.innerText.trim()===m)}p.click();await W(400);const s=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b)=>b.innerText.trim()==='검색(F8)'&&b.offsetParent);s&&s.click();await W(1500);const t=document.querySelector('table');return {head:[...t.querySelectorAll('thead tr')].map((r)=>r.innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim()),rows:[...t.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')].map((r)=>[...r.children].map((c)=>c.innerText.trim()))}};const a=await __our('재료비단가차이');const b=await __our('소모수량차이');window.__va=a;window.__vb=b;return JSON.stringify([a.head,a.rows.filter((r)=>r[0]==='ITM-0002'),b.rows.filter((r)=>r[0]==='ITM-0002')])})()

js:(async()=>{const h={Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token')};const cps=await (await fetch('/api/cost-periods',{headers:h})).json();const lg=await (await fetch('/api/cost-periods/'+cps[0].id+'/ledger',{headers:h})).json();const pr=await (await fetch('/api/productions',{headers:h})).json();const p=(pr.rows??pr).find((x)=>x.prodNo===sessionStorage.getItem('qaVarProd'));const price=(id)=>{const r=lg.rows.find((r)=>r.itemId===id);return r&&r.decreaseQty>0?r.decreaseAmount/r.decreaseQty:0};window.__cmpWant=Math.round(p.materials.reduce((n,m)=>n+m.quantity*price(m.componentId),0));{const lr=lg.rows.find((r)=>r.itemCode==='ITM-0002');window.__lg=lr?await (await fetch('/api/cost-periods/'+cps[0].id+'/ledger/'+lr.itemId,{headers:h})).json():null}window.__vc=await __our('원가비교집계표');window.__vl=await __our('노무비/경비/외주비차이');return JSON.stringify([window.__cmpWant,window.__lg,window.__vl.rows.filter((r)=>r[0]==='ITM-0002'),window.__vc.rows.filter((r)=>r[0]==='ITM-0002')])})()

finally: js:(async()=>{const h={Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token')};const no=sessionStorage.getItem('qaVarProd');if(no){const d=await (await fetch('/api/productions',{headers:h})).json();const p=(d.rows??d).find((x)=>x.prodNo===no);if(p)await fetch('/api/productions/'+p.id,{method:'DELETE',headers:h})}if(sessionStorage.getItem('qaVarCp')){const cps=await (await fetch('/api/cost-periods',{headers:h})).json();for(const c of cps.filter((c)=>c.startMonth===new Date().toISOString().slice(0,7)))await fetch('/api/cost-periods/'+c.id,{method:'DELETE',headers:h})}if(sessionStorage.getItem('qaVarBor')){const b=await (await fetch('/api/bor',{headers:h})).json();for(const o of (b.rows??b).filter((o)=>o.productCode==='ITM-0002'&&o.workName==='QA재고2-조립'))await fetch('/api/bor/'+o.id,{method:'DELETE',headers:h})}sessionStorage.removeItem('qaVarBor');sessionStorage.removeItem('qaVarProd');sessionStorage.removeItem('qaVarCp');return true})()
